Das seit vielen Jahren am Markt bestens etablierte, unabhängige, dynamische Familienunternehmen aus Hamburg mit weiteren internationalen Standorten ist Spezialist in seinem Segment. Die maßgeschneiderten Lösungen unseres Mandanten werden vielfältig in der Konsumgüter-, Pharma- und Kosmetikindustrie eingesetzt. Innovation, Qualität, technologisch führendes Know-how, langjährige Kundenbeziehungen, Zuverlässigkeit, speziell auf den Anwendungsfall der globalen Kunden zugeschnittene Lösungen sowie eine wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur sind die prägenden Erfolgskomponenten dieses Familienunternehmens. Mittelständische Strukturen, ein hoher Aktivitätsradius, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein internationales Setup bieten ein herausragendes Umfeld für die Gestaltung der weiteren Entwicklung des Unternehmens an exponierter Stelle.

Ihre Aufgaben

Der Stelleninhaber übernimmt die Gesamtverantwortung für die kommerzielle und innovationsbezogene Entwicklung der Unternehmensgruppe. Gesucht wird ausdrücklich kein klassischer Vertriebsleiter, sondern ein unternehmerischer Growth-, Leadership- und Execution-Leader, der bestehende Strategien und Businesspläne konsequent in Ergebnisse übersetzt. Die Aufgabe besteht darin, die Organisation von einer teilweise funktional geprägten Struktur zu einer modern-geführten, hoch performanten, kunden- und marktorientierten Wachstumsorganisation weiterzuentwickeln. Zentrale Aufgabe der Position ist die signifikante Erhöhung der organisatorischen und kommerziellen Geschwindigkeit des Unternehmens, um zu messbaren Ergebnissen zu gelangen. Sie verantworten den gesamten kommerziellen Bereich und steuern die strategische Ausrichtung des Geschäftsfelds am Standort Hamburg.

Ihr Profil

Gesucht wird eine überzeugende, umsetzungsstarke, nach vorne gehende international versierte Führungspersönlichkeit, die mit sehr viel Eigeninitiative und -verantwortung ihren Bereich steuert und entwickelt. Inhaltliche Voraussetzung für die Position ist die Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung internationaler Vertriebsorganisationen mit nachweisbarem Wachstumserfolg. Erfahrungen im Mittelstand – besonders bei inhabergeführten Unternehmen sind von Vorteil. Unternehmerisches und strategisches Denken, herausragendes Markt- und Kundenverständnis, überzeugende Führungskompetenz sowie exzellente Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind selbstverständliche Anforderungen.

Der Reiz der Position

Für den Positionsinhaber bietet sich die seltene Gelegenheit, ein etabliertes, inhabergeführtes, traditionsreiches Unternehmen gemeinsam mit dem Inhaber auf die nächste Ebene zu entwickeln. Dafür erhalten Sie großen Freiraum und Entscheidungsbefugnisse. Ein sehr attraktives, erfolgs- und langfrist-orientiertes Vergütungspaket rundet das sehr spannende Positionsangebot ab.

Nehmen Sie mit uns Kontakt auf

Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Kryptowährungen, Stablecoins und anderen tokenisierten Vermögenswerten) in Blockchain-Netzwerken. Unsere Lösung wird bereits von mehr als 50 institutionellen Kunden eingesetzt. Als lizenziertes Finanzinstitut wird die Tangany GmbH von der BaFin reguliert.

Für unser anhaltendes Wachstum suchen wir einen Financial Controller (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.

Das Team ist klein. Deine Expertise und dein Beitrag wirken sich unmittelbar aus: Du arbeitest mit unserer Accountant und unserer Steuerkanzlei z.B. an Themen wie Finanzbuchhaltung, Lohn und Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung; die formale Verantwortung für das Rechnungswesen liegt bei der Geschäftsleitung, Zahlungen geben wir im Vier-Augen-Prinzip frei. In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.

Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.

Aufgaben

data.description:
As a Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you will develop the electronic systems at the heart of our electric powertrain solutions, taking ownership from requirements and circuit design through PCB development, bring-up, verification and validation.

You will work hands-on across electrical architecture, power electronics, BMS and charging systems, collaborating closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Testing and Manufacturing. Your work will help us turn new electronics concepts into robust, reliable and production-ready hardware. This end-to-end scope is consistent with comparable senior electronics roles in Munich, where ownership typically extends from schematics and PCB design through prototype bring-up, EMC, validation and production transfer.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop electrical architectures and define system, subsystem and component requirements for electric powertrain and energy systems.

  • Own the complete PCBA development cycle, from schematic design and component selection through PCB implementation, manufacturing coordination, bring-up, verification and validation.

  • Develop and improve electronics for BMS, charging and power distribution systems, including troubleshooting and design updates.

  • Design hardware and test solutions for battery and charger development, including battery simulation and subsystem test benches.

  • Collaborate closely with Embedded Software and other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless hardware/software and system integration.

  • Plan and execute hardware verification and validation activities, including subsystem-level testing, debugging and root-cause analysis.

  • Support EMC/compliance activities and implement design improvements based on test results.

  • Support the transition from prototypes to reliable, manufacturable hardware together with suppliers, manufacturing partners and internal teams.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have a degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • You have several years of professional experience in electronics or hardware development, ideally with ownership across the full development lifecycle.

  • You have professional experience working with Altium Designer for PCB design and development.

  • You have strong hands-on experience in schematic design, PCB/PCBA development, bring-up and hardware debugging.

  • You have a solid understanding of analog and digital electronics, power electronics and embedded hardware.

  • You are confident working in an electronics laboratory with equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters and power supplies.

  • Ideally, you have experience with BMS, chargers, electric powertrains, EMC/compliance testing or other safety- or reliability-critical electronic systems.

  • You are a structured and pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys taking technical ownership and working hands-on.

  • Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German language skills are considered a plus.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

We are looking for a highly analytical, action-oriented, and entrepreneurial Website Growth & CRO Manager to take ownership of our websites and help turn them into high-performing digital sales channels.

You will take ownership of conversion rates, identify opportunities for growth, and turn insights into tangible improvements. We’re looking for someone who thinks analytically, moves quickly, and enjoys taking ideas from insight to execution. Early-career candidates with exceptional analytical ability, initiative, and potential are also encouraged to apply.

  • Website Product Ownership: Take ownership of existing websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance and the customer journey.

  • UX/UI & Web Experience: Create intuitive, visually compelling, and high-converting web experiences in collaboration with designers and AI tools.
  • Copywriting & Messaging: Develop persuasive headlines, unique selling propositions (USPs), calls to action (CTAs), and website copy in German that clearly communicate the value proposition and encourage users to take action.
  • Growth Experiments & User Research: Translate data and customer insights into actionable improvements. Independently conduct customer surveys and user research to identify friction points and growth opportunities.
  • Product Development: Contribute to building a new product configurator and help shape the digital experience around the products.

  • AI-powered Execution: Use AI tools proactively to accelerate workflows, explore solutions, and improve the quality and speed of execution.

Requirements

  • MUST: German at C1 or C2 level. You will write and optimize website texts in German as a key part of your work. Profiles with a lower level of German will not be considered.
  • Strong analytical thinking and commercial understanding, with the ability to turn data into clear priorities and measurable improvements.
  • Experience or demonstrated potential in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Growth Design, or E-commerce.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to prioritize, take initiative, and drive ideas through to execution.

  • Experience level: We welcome candidates with approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience, but exceptional early-career candidates with 1–2 years of experience and a strong analytical mindset, high initiative, and outstanding potential are also encouraged to apply.

Why Join Us?

  • An international and entrepreneurial environment: Work with colleagues across Berlin, Wrocław, and Helsingborg.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our mission is to provide transparency & access to private markets by building a tech-based platform enabling funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, process-driven Investor Onboarding Manager to join our Operations team at bunch. This role will own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds across multiple markets, especially the Netherlands, the UK, and Germany, by managing documentation, investor communication, KYC/AML pre-checks, and closings. This is an individual contributor role in a growing Investor Onboarding team, reporting to the Investor Onboarding Lead.

How the role contributes to the company's vision

  • Ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality onboarding experience for investors by owning onboarding workflows end to end with precision and care

  • Help funds close on time by keeping investor files complete, compliant, and finalised in coordination with fund managers, AML officers, and internal teams

  • Keep onboarding in line with jurisdiction-specific requirements across Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK, including investor qualification, FATCA/CRS, and signing rules

  • Drive consistency and operational excellence by keeping SOPs current and turning edge cases and lessons learned into process improvements

  • Help scale onboarding by identifying inefficiencies and working with our platform partner and Product team to improve the investor experience

Top responsibilities

  • Own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds and SPVs, from new-fund setup to closing

  • Carry out KYC/AML pre-checks for individual and entity investors, including IDs, proof of address, register extracts, UBOs, FATCA/CRS self-certifications, and investor classification

  • Prepare complete files for review by AML officers and UK regulatory hosts, and coordinate with them through to approval

  • Send clear, consolidated document requests to investors and guide them through the process with regular follow-ups

  • Plan and coordinate closings, including signing and counter-signature, and provide internal teams with a complete closing summary

  • Act as the main investor onboarding contact for fund managers and Account Managers on assigned funds, guiding them through the standard process and documenting key decisions in writing

  • Keep SOPs for the relevant workflows up to date, document edge cases, and share clear, actionable feedback with our platform partner and Product team

  • Provide cover for colleagues’ funds during absences and peak periods

What you should bring with you

  • At least 2 years of experience in investor or client onboarding, KYC/KYB, or AML operations, ideally in fund administration, private banking, or fintech

  • Solid KYC/KYB judgement: UBO identification on entity structures, document standards, register checks, and working knowledge of FATCA/CRS and investor classification

  • A strong sense of ownership: seeing work through to completion and raising risks early, together with a proposed way forward

  • High attention to detail: a habit of double-checking work and addressing mistakes openly and quickly

  • Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and precise with investors, and confident in setting expectations with stakeholders

  • Able to stay organised during busy closing periods, manage several closings in parallel, and re-prioritise as needed

  • Comfortable working across multiple tools and systems, including onboarding platforms, e-signature, project management tools, and shared inboxes, and open to using AI tools in daily work

  • A good match with our values: Own it, Aim for impact, Empower others, Always be curious, and Enjoy the ride

  • English fluency required; German at B1–B2 level or above is a plus

  • Nice to have: experience in investor relations or fund/legal operations, or familiarity with private market fund structures

Why you should join bunch

  • Work at the heart of investor operations, gaining firsthand experience in private market processes that support leading investment funds

  • Join a driven, collaborative team that values precision, transparency, and shared ownership of outcomes

  • Make direct impact in a fast-growing company alongside professionals passionate about transforming private market infrastructure

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

  • 4 remote calendar weeks/year

  • 28 days of vacation, 2 company days, plus local public holidays

What your interview journey will look like

  1. Screening Call – with Tahira from our Talent Acquisition team, to get acquainted with bunch and understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  2. Hiring Manager Interview – with Evgenii, our Investor Onboarding Lead, to discuss your experience, how you work, and the role in detail

  3. Case Study – a short, realistic onboarding case, prepared in advance and discussed together, to demonstrate your expertise, way of thinking, and how you communicate your output

  4. Final Interview – with Aylin Üzsal, our VP of Operations, to discuss your journey, your goals, and your overall personal purpose

About bunch

bunch is Europe’s leading tech-enabled fund administrator for VC, PE, and alternative assets. By combining AI-powered automation with deep domain expertise, we provide a single source of truth that replaces outdated, fragmented processes, and enables clients to master the entire fund lifecycle.

Private markets are experiencing unprecedented growth; with alternative assets projected to reach $40 trillion by the end of the decade. To power this growth, we have raised €22.8 million to date—including our $15.5M Series A in July 2024—and are accelerating our mission to build the backbone of private markets in Europe.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Berlin, bunch has expanded to Amsterdam, London, and Luxembourg, now supporting over 500 investment structures, 150 fund and asset managers, and more than 10,000 institutional investors. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we are looking for ambitious talent to continue redefining this financial category.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

data.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time.

Your Role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it.

This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work.

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it.

*This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required.

What you will own in your first year

  • The people agenda for your client groups. How the teams are structured, where the next leaders come from, and which roles the business cannot afford to lose.

  • The next performance and calibration cycle in your areas, from manager preparation through to the conversations that follow.

  • The career framework for the business areas you support. Our company-wide framework sets the levels and the principles. You build the specific version underneath it with your leaders, so that a mechanical engineer and an electrical engineer can each see what growth looks like in their own discipline.

  • Manager capability in your groups. By the end of the year, your leaders set clearer expectations and have the difficult conversation earlier than they do today.

What You'll Do

Most weeks start with a leader and a problem that is not yet well defined. A team that has doubled and stopped delivering. A strong engineer who is struggling as a manager. Two groups that both believe they own the same work. You ask enough questions to find what is underneath, bring options with a recommendation, and stay with the decision until it has landed.

Alongside that you will:

  • Coach managers on expectations, direct feedback and conversations they would rather postpone.

  • Handle employee relations cases with care and sound judgment, within German employment law.

  • Work with Talent Acquisition on hiring priorities and with People Operations on everything from contract type to exit, so leaders get one joined-up answer.

  • Use people data to show leaders what is happening in their teams and what you would do about it.

Priorities move here, and some processes are still being built. You will often be the person building them.

What You Bring

  • Experience as an HR Business Partner in a deep-tech or engineering-heavy company while it was growing fast.

  • Something you built yourself. A performance process, a leveling framework, compensation bands. We will ask what you personally designed, what you would do differently, and what happened after rollout.

  • Strong German employment law and GDPR, plus a working knowledge of People Operations, including how contract types and payroll deadlines shape a decision.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Based in or near Darmstadt, or ready to relocate.

The leaders you will work with are engineers. They respond to a precise question and a clear recommendation backed by evidence, and they notice quickly when either is missing. If that sounds like a room you enjoy, you will do well here.

It helps if you have seen both a well-run large company and a scale-up, or have partnered with technical and scientific leaders before.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and stock options, so you hold a stake in what we build.

  • A company contribution of 20% on top of your own payments into a private pension plan, plus loyalty incentives.

  • 30 days of vacation.

  • A mobility budget through NAVIT for public transport, car sharing or taxi, and access to gyms and studios across Europe through Wellhub.

Dabei übernimmst du schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und entwickelst dich in Microsoft 365, Endgeräteverwaltung, IT-Sicherheit und Automatisierung weiter.

  • IT-Support: Du unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden und Partnerunternehmen bei technischen Fragen und bearbeitest Supportanfragen im First- und Second-Level-Support. Bei komplexeren Problemen arbeitest du gemeinsam mit dem Senior IT-Systemadministrator an einer Lösung.

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du hast eine IT-Ausbildung, beispielsweise zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, ein Studium mit IT-Bezug oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen. Auch motivierte Berufseinsteiger mit passenden praktischen Kenntnissen sind willkommen.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist selbstverständlich. Für den persönlichen Austausch wünschen wir uns mindestens zwei gemeinsame Bürotage pro Woche, bevorzugt in Hamburg oder alternativ in Berlin.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die IT-Landschaft der Prokuras Gruppe weiterzuentwickeln. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!

data.title: EVENT- MANAGER (w/m/d)

data.description:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d), you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports.

Your responsibilities

  • Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis, including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations.
  • Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts.
  • Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies.
  • Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications.
  • Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes.
  • Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting.
  • Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead.
  • Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy).
  • Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions.
  • Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure.
  • Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH.

Your availability

  • We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month.

Travel

  • Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun!
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years;
  • An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience;
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU);
  • Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class;
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • 30 holidays.

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.

The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.

Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.

Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

About the role:

You will design, build and run scalable, reliable and secure cloud services that support Quantum Systems in its mission to become the leader in autonomous multi-domain systems for air, ground and water.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the architecture, design and long-term direction of our backend services and cloud platform.

  • Design, build and run high-performance, highly scalable backend services in Java.

  • Build and operate cloud-native applications and microservices with a strong focus on reliability, security and observability.

  • Define and maintain our cloud infrastructure as code, and make sure environments stay reproducible, auditable and secure.

  • Design and integrate APIs and data pipelines that connect our autonomous systems with cloud services.

  • Lead the resolution of complex production issues and drive post-incident improvements to keep systems up and stable.

  • Set engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD and operations, and lead their adoption across the team.

  • Work with product, platform and hardware teams to turn requirements into sound technical solutions.

  • Mentor and guide other engineers through code reviews, design discussions and knowledge sharing.

  • Evaluate new technologies and cloud trends and introduce them where they add clear value.




What you bring to the team:

  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java (modern versions, Java 17+), including several years in a senior or lead role.

  • Deep expertise in Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, and a track record of designing RESTful APIs and microservice architectures.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also welcome), including production operations.

  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, Bicep or similar), including designing reusable modules and managing multi-environment setups.

  • Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and of building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including instrumenting services and building metrics, logs, traces and alerts.

  • Solid experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases and with messaging or event-driven architectures.

  • A deep understanding of security, scalability, resilience and performance in distributed systems.

  • A track record of making architectural decisions and seeing them through to production.

  • The ability to work independently, take ownership of ambiguous problems and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

Odoo entwickelt eine Suite von Open-Source-Betriebsanwendungen, die Unternehmensprozesse von CRM und E-Commerce bis hin zu Buchhaltung und Lagerhaltung abdecken. Das Ziel ist es, einer der weltweit führenden Open-Source-Anbieter zu sein und Software bereitzustellen, die gleichzeitig einfach zu bedienen und voll integriert ist.

Deine Aufgaben

Während wir den Großteil unserer Kund:innen mit der Odoo-Standardversion begeistern, entwickeln wir für spezielle Anforderungen maßgeschneiderte Features. Als Software Engineer verwandelst du diese Anforderungen in die Realität und begleitest den gesamten Prozess von der technischen Analyse über die Entwicklung bis hin zum Support. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Inhouse Business Analysten zusammen.

Wofür bist du verantwortlich?

  • Wirkungsvolle Lösungen entwickeln: In engem Austausch mit unseren Business Analysten übersetzt du die Wünsche unserer Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen in smarte, maßgeschneiderte Odoo-Features.

  • Enge Schnittstellen-Kommunikation: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Berliner Business Analysten und stehst im ständigen Austausch mit unseren internationalen Developer-Teams, um Best Practices zu teilen und komplexe Anforderungen optimal umzusetzen.

  • Nachhaltigen Erfolg sichern: Du wartest, optimierst und betreust die von dir entwickelten Individuallösungen, um langfristig höchste Qualität zu gewährleisten.

  • Unsere Partner befähigen: Durch deine technische Expertise und Beratung unterstützt du unsere Partner dabei, herausragende Odoo-Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Fundierter Start: Du absolvierst dein Onboarding in unserem Headquarter in Belgien (inkl. voller Übernahme von Reise- und Unterkunftskosten), lernst unsere internen Standards kennen und vernetzt dich direkt mit den internationalen Dev-Teams.

Unsere Working Tools:

  • Programmiersprachen: Python & JavaScript

  • Datenbank: PostgreSQL (mit object-relational mapping)

  • Collaboration Platform: GitHub

  • Framework: Odoo (ORM, Workflows, Report Engine, BI, AI)

  • Entwicklungsmodell: Open Source mit einer starken weltweiten Community

Das bringst du mit

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-C2).

  • Hintergrund: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, eine Fachinformatiker-Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Technische Skills: Du beherrschst mindestens eine Programmiersprache gut und hast Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit relationalen Datenbanken.

  • Lösungsorientierte Mentalität: Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren, logisch zu durchdenken und in sauberen, effizienten Code zu übersetzen.

  • Kund:innenorientierung: Du verstehst die Business-Logik hinter den Code-Zeilen und hast den Anspruch, echten Mehrwert für die Endanwender zu schaffen.

  • Eigeninitiative & Lernbereitschaft: Du agierst selbstständig, arbeitest dich schnell in neue Frameworks ein und hast Lust, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Kommunikationsstärke & Teamgeist: Du kommunizierst aktiv, klar und transparent. So stellst du eine reibungslose Abstimmung mit deinen Inhouse-Kolleg:innen und den internationalen Teams sicher.

  • Reisebereitschaft für das Onboarding: Bereitschaft für eine temporäre Einarbeitungsphase in unserem Headquarter in Belgien zu arbeiten.

Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

Deine Benefits

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.

  • Sachbezug oder Urban Sports: Mit deinen monatlichen 50 € hast du die Wahl: Lass dir das Guthaben flexibel auf eine Mastercard buchen oder entscheide dich alternativ für eine Urban Sports M-Mitgliedschaft.

  • Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.

  • Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.

  • Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.

data.description:
Driving Digital Technologies.

Den digitalen Wandel begleiten und aktiv mitgestalten – unsere Mission bei citema. Als kontinuierlich wachsendes Unternehmen mit solider Basis bieten wir Dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten in einem hochinteressanten, dynamischen Umfeld.

Wir suchen Dich als Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) Ground Control Software am Standort Augsburg/Aichach (hybrid).

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Du entwickelst Software für ein Luftverteidigungssystem mit Schwerpunkt auf Integration.

  • Du entwickelst und testest die Feuerleitsoftware des Systems.

  • Du führst Entwicklungsarbeiten in den Bereichen Implementierung, Test und Integration durch.

  • Du unterstützt die Integration der Software in das Gesamtsystem und stimmst dich mit internen und externen Schnittstellenpartnern ab.

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Du hast ein technisches Studium im Bereich Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrungen in allen Phasen der Softwareentwicklung, Deine bevorzugte Programmiersprache ist Rust, alternativ C++.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Embedded-Softwareentwicklung auf ARM-Systemen.

  • Du kennst dich mit den Netzwerkprotokollen TCP und TSN aus.

  • Idealerweise bringst Du Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Bereich Bodenkontrollsysteme und Algorithmen mit.

  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Echtzeit-Linux, verteilte Hardwarearchitekturen sowie Virtualisierung und Emulation sind von Vorteil.

  • Du bist mit gängigen Softwareentwicklungsprozessen wie dem V-Modell oder agilen Methoden vertraut.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit verschiedenen Toolumgebungen und Frameworks in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich

Das bieten wir Dir

Deine Ideen. Deine Entwicklung. Unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur spannende Technologien, sondern auch die Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Zukunft aktiv gestalten: Arbeite an innovativen Technologien und gestalte digitale Entwicklungen mit.

  • Flexibel arbeiten: Profitiere von unserem hybriden New-Work-Modell.

  • Sicher durchstarten: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.

  • Mehr für Dich: Nutze Deine givve Card als steuerfreien Unternehmensbenefit.

  • Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze Deinen Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum.

  • Persönlich weiterkommen: Entwickle Dich mit individuellen Karriereperspektiven gezielt weiter.

  • Gemeinsam mehr erreichen: Profitiere vom Wissenstransfer und Zusammenhalt in einem starken Team.

  • Technologie erleben: Entdecke vielfältige Technologien und arbeite an anspruchsvollen, sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen.

Und das Wichtigste: spannende Herausforderungen, echte Teamarbeit und die Möglichkeit, etwas zu bewegen.

data.description:
Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI

Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)

About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations.

This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task

  • Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders

  • Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties

  • Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks

  • Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest

  • Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms

  • Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date

  • Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup to new tools and internal structures, you take on whatever matters most that week

  • Automate with AI — turn processes that still run manually into workflows with AI tools and agents, such as our lead pipeline, reporting and contract database

  • Be the founders' right hand — prepare meetings, follow up on decisions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program, ideally a Master's, in business, industrial engineering, computer science, real estate, hospitality, finance or a related field

  • First practical experience through internships or working student roles, ideally in a startup, real estate, hospitality, consulting or finance

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence with numbers, Excel or Google Sheets

  • You build with AI, not just write with it: workflows, automations or small tools, for example with Claude, n8n/Make, Python or no-code tools

  • A genuine hands-on mentality — you get things done yourself instead of waiting for instructions

  • A structured, reliable way of working and the ability to juggle several topics at once

  • Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written)

  • A driver's license and willingness to travel to our properties and development sites

  • Discretion in handling confidential information

Nice-to-Have

  • First experience with financial modelling, real estate transactions or project development

  • Basic knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting software

  • Interest in hospitality, architecture and Tiny Houses

  • Experience with Notion or similar tools

What We Offer

  • Direct collaboration with the founders - your work has visibility and impact from day one

  • Responsibility early on: you take ownership of your own topics quickly, and if we're a good fit, there is a perspective to stay with us after the internship

  • A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500+ units - you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens

  • Insight into every part of a hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations

  • Free stays in all ALPAMI properties, from our City Boutique Houses to our Tiny Houses in Nature

  • The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership

  • Fair internship compensation

  • A nice office in Munich

  • Frequent team events

  • Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being

How to Apply

data.description:
Du willst nicht nur irgendeinen dualen Studienplatz, sondern Content machen, der wirklich etwas bewegt? Du liebst Fitness, verstehst die Community und willst Theorie und Praxis direkt verbinden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir sind ein aufstrebendes Unternehmen mit mittlerweile über 30 Leuten im Team. Unter unserem Dach vereinen wir mehrere Gesellschaften und ihre Marken: die MainTea GmbH mit Besser im Glas (Tee & Gewürze), die POWAFOOD GmbH mit Bubble Pop (Bubble Tea) und PRO2BE (Proteinprodukte) sowie die SMOOOTH IT GmbH mit SMOOOTH IT, unserem Shop-in-Shop-System für frisch gemixte Smoothies.

Ab März 2027 kannst du bei uns ein duales Studium starten und wirst Teil unserer Marke PRO2BE. Wenn du schon dual studierst, ist ein früherer Einstieg möglich. Du lernst Content Creation von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post, mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem nahbaren Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

Aufgaben

  • Du wirst eines der Gesichter von PRO2BE und begeisterst unsere Follower mit echter Leidenschaft für Fitness und Proteinprodukte

  • Du erstellst Social-Media-Content für PRO2BE, von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Post

  • Du planst Drehs und setzt sie um, vor und hinter der Kamera

  • Du erkennst Fitness-Trends früh und setzt sie schnell in starken Content um

  • Du schneidest Videos für Instagram und TikTok und lernst, was einen guten Cut ausmacht

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen für Formate und Konzepte ein, die PRO2BE im Fitnessbereich stärken

  • Du unterstützst uns bei Produktlaunches, Verkostungen und Messen

Qualifikation

  • Du bist bereits in einem dualen Studiengang eingeschrieben und suchst einen neuen Praxispartner, oder du planst die Einschreibung zum Sommersemester 2027

  • Du hast echtes Interesse an Fitness, Sport und Proteinprodukten und ein gutes Verständnis für die Fitness-Community

  • Du fühlst dich vor und hinter der Kamera wohl

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung in der Content Creation, zum Beispiel mit einem eigenen Kanal oder Projekten

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Instagram und TikTok, erste Erfahrung mit Schnittprogrammen ist ein Plus

  • Du arbeitest kreativ, aber strukturiert und zuverlässig

Benefits

  • Team & Kultur: Offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Arbeitsumfeld mit regelmäßigen Teamevents und echter Hands-on-Mentalität

  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Echter Gestaltungsspielraum statt Kaffee kochen. Du prägst eine wachsende Marke aktiv mit und lernst Content Creation von Grund auf

  • Perspektive: Die Chance, nach deinem Studium langfristig Teil des Teams zu bleiben

  • Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: Frisches Team-Lunch an drei Tagen pro Woche durch unsere Köchin und eine wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre

Wenn du Bock hast, PRO2BE während deines Studiums aktiv mitzuprägen, sollten wir uns kennenlernen. data.description:
Sie kümmern sich um unsere Mandanten. Wir kümmern uns um Sie.

Klingt nach einem guten Deal? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Referent Digitale Transformation (m/w/d) gesucht.

Wer wir sind.

Kompetente Beratung, neu und „NAU“ gedacht. Getreu unserem Grundsatz beraten wir sowohl national als auch international tätige Unternehmen, Freiberufler diverser Branchen und Größenklassen sowie vermögende Privatpersonen in allen Bereichen des Steuerrechts. Hinter dem „wir“ verbirgt sich eine moderne und innovative Partnerschaft zwischen Steuerberatern und einem über 25 Personen umfassenden Team in zentraler Lage des Frankfurter Nordends.

Aufgaben

Was Ihre Aufgaben sein werden.

Sie sind ein elementares Bindeglied in der Dreiecksbeziehung zwischen uns als Kanzlei, unseren Mandanten und der Finanzverwaltung und sorgen so für die Standardisierung, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung von wichtigen Geschäftsprozessen. Konkret kümmern Sie sich um Themen wie die Einrichtung von Schnittstellen, die Implementierung und Schulung von neuen Programmen sowie das technische Onboarding neuer Mandanten.

Qualifikation

Was wir uns von Ihnen wünschen.

Sie kümmern sich um die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kanzlei. Was einfach klingt, ist gerade aufgrund der sich rasant ändernden Vorschriften und Technologien eine Herausforderung, die wir gemeinsam angehen werden.

Wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden, haben Sie optimale Voraussetzungen, um Teil unseres Teams zu werden.

  • Sie begegnen Veränderungen aufgeschlossen und möchten sich beruflich sowie persönlich weiterentwickeln
  • Sie haben eine Affinität für digitale Anwendungen und effiziente Prozesse
  • Sie sind mit den Konzepten, Methoden und Technologien einer modernen Steuerberatung vertraut
  • Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine für die Aufgabe einschlägige Qualifikation (z.B. Weiterbildung Fibutroniker, Fachassistent Digitalisierung und IT-Prozesse, etc.) oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung an der Schnittstelle Kanzlei, Mandant und Finanzverwaltung
  • Sie besitzen ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in MS-Office und DATEV

Benefits

Was wir Ihnen bieten.

Wir kümmern uns um Sie. Unser Versprechen nehmen wir persönlich, weshalb wir zum Start unserer gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit einen auf Ihre persönlichen Bedürfnisse und Ziele abgestimmten Onboarding- und Karriereplan entwickeln, den wir im Zuge unserer Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Der Karriereplan inkludiert unter anderem Aufgabenbereiche, die auf Ihre individuellen Stärken und Schwächen zugeschnitten sind, sowie individuell von Ihnen wählbare Benefits, die auch wirklich zu Ihren Bedürfnissen passen.

Warum zu uns.

Wir haben für unser Team ein positives Arbeitsumfeld geschaffen. Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und erfolgreiches Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird. Deshalb bieten wir neben spannenden Projekten und herausfordernden Mandaten viele weitere Vorteile und Arbeitgeberleistungen an. Was ist Ihnen wichtig? Lassen Sie es uns wissen!

data.description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Bei FlixTrain hat Sicherheit im Eisenbahnbetrieb oberste Priorität. Als Safety Inspector (m/w/d) stellst du die Überwachung der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden gemäß den Vorgaben der FlixTrain sicher, führst Prüfungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass Regelwerke konsequent umgesetzt werden - im Alltag wie in Ausnahmesituationen. Du agierst mit hoher Fachkompetenz, Fingerspitzengefühl und klarer Haltung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb, Mitarbeitenden und Behörden.

Über die Rolle

  • Du führst Betriebskontrollen und Überwachungsfahrten durch und wertest Fahrdaten gemäß den Sicherheitszielen aus
  • Das Qualifikationsmanagement inklusive Führung der „Betrieblichen Akte" der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand
  • Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen
  • Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW
  • Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH
  • An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen
  • Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge

Über Dich

  • Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit
  • Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands
  • Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau
  • Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt
  • Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften
  • Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit.  
  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen und Teil einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden. Aufgaben

  • Sie entwickeln und optimieren SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Sie begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Tests und Dokumentation.

  • Sie wirken an der Umstellung auf SAP S/4HANA und der Modernisierung der bestehenden Systemlandschaft mit.

  • Sie unterstützen produktionsnahe SAP-Prozesse, insbesondere im Umfeld von SAP PP und der Maschinenanbindung.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.

  • Sie haben mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten.

  • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Kenntnisse der SAP Business Technology Platform sowie Erfahrung mit Schnittstellentechnologien wie OData, IDoc oder BAPI.

Benefits

  • Attraktiver Gehaltsrahmen: Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation etwa 70.000 bis 90.000 Euro brutto jährlich auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • Homeoffice: Nach der Einarbeitung sind bis zu 80% Homeoffice möglich. Auch gebündelte Präsenzphasen (1 Woche vor Ort, 3 Wochen Homeoffice) sind umsetzbar.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Fachlicher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliche Entwicklungsaufgaben und die Möglichkeit, die SAP-S/4HANA-Transformation unmittelbar mitzuprägen.

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Massageangebote, Corporate Benefits, ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket und vergünstigte Lademöglichkeiten für Elektrofahrzeuge. Nach der Probezeit stehen außerdem Dienstrad-Leasing und eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung zur Verfügung.

data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Solutions Architect on TRM's Onchain Compliance - EMEA team, you are the technical owner of the sales cycle for crypto exchanges, banks, fintechs, and payments companies. You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the technical win on strategic onchain compliance deals, using TRM's platform and AI-assisted workflows to turn each customer's compliance process into an architecture they trust. This directly determines whether TRM lands and keeps tier 1 accounts.

  • Compress time to value by building tailored, AI-assisted demos within days of discovery, showing compliance teams how TRM plus AI cuts manual alert review.

  • Design and prove API integrations that fit real compliance operations, including alert triage, case management, and escalation, and use AI tooling to prototype them quickly.

  • Build reusable, AI-enabled demo and integration assets so every deal moves faster than the last and the team scales without adding manual work.

  • Feed field insight back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap so TRM stays ahead of what compliance teams need next.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in pre- and post-sales technical roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer), increasingly using AI tools in your workflow.

  • Hands-on experience scoping, implementing, and supporting API-based SaaS integrations, including using AI to prototype and test them faster.

  • Comfort with REST APIs and scripting in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and with AI coding assistants to build quick prototypes.

  • Familiarity with AML, KYC, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, and interest in applying AI to speed compliance review.

  • Daily use of AI tools with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it.

  • Strong discovery, prioritization across several opportunities at once, and clear communication with both engineers and senior compliance leaders.

  • Bonus: blockchain fundamentals, crypto compliance regulation, or experience building AI-enabled workflows. If you are excited by the mission but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply.

About the Team:

  • Solutions Architecture at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that works asynchronously through Slack and detailed documentation.

  • The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering.

  • The work is intellectually demanding. You translate complex compliance and blockchain problems into clear solutions under real deal pressure.

  • Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and account POD calls, with regular direct customer engagement.

  • Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

  • Travel 20 to 30 percent for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call rotation.

  • Frequency: Occasional off-hours escalations for live customer incidents (HM to confirm at intake).

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: As needed for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

  • Frequency: 20 to 30 percent.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional customer onsite visits.

  • Frequency: HM to confirm at intake.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within days of discovery, you put a demo built around the customer's compliance workflow in front of them, not a generic walkthrough.

  • Within days of a customer's commitment, you have agreed success criteria and a live pilot environment.

  • In the first 90 days, you build reusable demo and integration assets that cut setup time on the next deal.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

data.description:
From autonomous vehicles to medical devices, we believe the electronics industry is at the heart of global innovation - and we’re here to remove the bottlenecks that slow it down.

Luminovo helps innovators to bring new electronic products to life: faster, cheaper, and more sustainably.

Join us and shape the future of technology!

🚀 Your opportunity

  • You are passionate about Customer Success and a B2B SaaS enthusiast?

  • You want to leave a strong footprint in a market and help shape how Luminovo grows in Italy?

  • You want to be a strategic partner for your customers, not a transactional support agent?

  • You want to create measurable impact across a trillion-dollar industry?

Then this is your opportunity and we want you! 🫵

🎯 Performance objectives

As our Italian-speaking Customer Success Manager, you own the full customer lifecycle for our Italian accounts: onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion. As our first point of contact for Italian customers, you’ll have a big say in how we build our presence in the Italian market and grow it from here.

🚀 Onboarding and implementation

  • Go-live: Take new Italian customers from kickoff to their first live quotes in Luminovo, running user trainings and workshops in Italian.

  • Rescue: When a rollout drifts or a customer loses track, rebuild the plan with them, spot implementation risk early, and bring in the right stakeholders before it turns into a churn risk.

💚 Retention

  • Portfolio: Own the Italian customer portfolio. Keep every account’s health current and run business reviews that show customers what Luminovo has changed for them, such as faster quote turnaround and hours saved.

  • Renewals: Secure renewals across your portfolio by catching churn signals months ahead and acting on them.

📈 Expansion

  • Growth: Qualify expansion opportunities (new modules, more users, more sites) and take them to signature, involving Sales in the negotiation when needed.

🔁 Product and AI

  • Product expertise: Within your first three months, answer your accounts’ product questions yourself, escalating only real bugs and roadmap topics.

  • Customer voice: Document the problems Italian users run into, with real examples, so Product can prioritize them, and tell the customer when a fix ships.

  • AI in daily work: Within your first six months, automate one repetitive part of your portfolio work (account prep, health checks, call notes) with AI tools and share it with the team. We are a supply chain platform deeply rooted in AI, and as Luminerds, we practice what we preach to the electronics industry!

Disclaimer: While existing industry knowledge can be a major advantage for this role, what counts is whether you’re a fast learner, motivated to dive deep into complex
software, and excited about electronics!

🤓 Whom you’ll be working with

  • Markus, our Head of Customer Success, who you’ll work with mainly on retention and expansion

  • Rachel, our Solutions Team Manager, who you’ll work with closely on onboarding and implementation

  • Sebastian, one of our founders, who leads the Revenue department

  • Max, who leads our Revenue Operations team and is in charge of our CRM (HubSpot), supporting you with dashboards, sequences, forecasts, and more

  • Mark, our Head of Marketing, to align on positioning and messaging and drive strategic growth initiatives

  • Our Sales and Product teams, to fully understand our product roadmap and potential constraints, and to share product-related customer feedback

🏡 Work setup & travel

  • For this role in Italy, we hire on a freelancer contract only. You can find all the information on how that works here: Freelancers with Luminovo GmbH.

  • You can join our team remotely in Italy. We regularly meet for team on-sites and attend selected industry events, which means you’ll be traveling occasionally. Travel expenses will of course be covered by us.

💬 Language requirements

You’ll mainly work with Italian-speaking customers, so fluent 🇮🇹 Italian and 🇬🇧 English are a must for this role. German or any other language is, of course, a big plus.

⚡️ Our product

Luminovo is the first all-in-one supply chain platform built specifically for the electronics industry. Whether it’s an OEM designing electronic products, an EMS assembling them, or a PCB supplier manufacturing the printed circuit boards, our platform helps them control and optimize their complete electronics supply chain.

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Besides the language requirements, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than about your CV. If you’re interested in why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.
