Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them
  • Lead the AI-driven transformation of the entire finance function, from planning and controlling to accounting and reporting, with clear governance and review steps.

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Proven experience in designing and running AI-supported finance processes across a full finance function, including integration with ERP and finance systems, controls and data protection (GDPR), and measurable impact.
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English is required (C1 or above), as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Join one of Europe’s most sought-after TikTok Shop agencies and take ownership of the engine behind high-performing TikTok Shops.

  • Shop Ownership: You take operational ownership of a selection of our core TikTok Shops – ensuring pricing, promotions, campaigns, listings, stock, and overall shop health are always on track.

  • Good English skills for internal communication; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Make an Impact: Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes – your ideas don’t get stuck in endless approval rounds. They get put into action.

Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.

Your Mission

  • End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.
  • Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.
  • Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.
  • Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments.
  • Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset
  • Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase.
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures.
  • Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants.
  • Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing.
  • Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build.
  • Proactive mindset with strong autonomy and initiative in a dynamic environment
  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus.

Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes
    • Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities
    • Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.

Unternehmensbeschreibung

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

Wir suchen einen Product Engineer (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Tech-Teams bei Buying Labs - idealerweise am Standort Hamburg oder, wenn es fachlich und persönlich gut passt, auch remote. In dieser Position verbindest du fundierte technische Fähigkeiten mit ausgeprägtem Produktdenken. Du entwickelst mithilfe von KI Tools und Funktionen, die echten Mehrwert für unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie für unser Unternehmen schaffen. Dabei verantwortest du Features ganzheitlich - von der Definition des Umfangs und der Konzeption über die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Nutzung. In jeder Phase setzt du KI ein, um intelligentere Lösungen schneller zu entwickeln.

Diese Position richtet sich an Menschen, die gerne etwas aufbauen und denen die Wirkung ihrer Arbeit wichtig ist: Menschen, die sowohl die Perspektive der Nutzerinnen und Nutzer als auch die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, den erforderlichen Entwicklungsumfang klar definieren können und die geplanten Lösungen anschließend erfolgreich umsetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Produktentwicklung: Du verantwortest Features vom ersten Konzept bis zum Einsatz in der Produktivumgebung und bei echten Nutzerinnen und Nutzern – nicht nur den Code. Du lieferst vollständige Lösungen, die einen messbaren geschäftlichen Mehrwert schaffen. Dabei konkretisierst du Anforderungen, definierst technische Lösungsansätze und setzt Funktionen sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend um. Qualität wird von Anfang an berücksichtigt und durch geeignete Tests sichergestellt.
  • Produktdenken und Nutzerorientierung: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse und leitest daraus ab, was entwickelt werden sollte und warum. Produktideen und Anforderungen verschiedener Stakeholder verwandelst du in überzeugende Lösungen, die tatsächlich genutzt werden.
  • Integration von KI in unsere Produkte: Du konzipierst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in unsere Plattform. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Einsatz von Programmierassistenten, sondern um die Entwicklung konkreter KI-Lösungen für reale Herausforderungen unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer. Du erkennst Potenziale, bei denen KI Arbeitsabläufe beschleunigen, Entscheidungen verbessern oder völlig neue Möglichkeiten eröffnen kann.
  • Datenmodellierung und skalierbare Systeme: Du entwickelst solide Datenmodelle und skalierbare Architekturen, die eine zuverlässige Grundlage für unsere Produkte bilden. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben überführst du in gemeinsam nutzbare Bausteine – beispielsweise UI-Komponenten, Datenimportprozesse oder KI-Pipelines. Dadurch lässt sich jedes neue Tool schneller entwickeln als das vorherige.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und Förderung der Nutzung: Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammen – von der Geschäftsleitung bis zu den operativen Teams –, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung neuer Tools und Funktionen voranzutreiben. Technische Konzepte vermittelst du verständlich und schaffst organisationsweit Akzeptanz für deine Lösungen.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du holst frühzeitig Feedback ein, entwickelst Lösungen in kurzen Zyklen weiter und verbesserst deine Arbeit kontinuierlich. Du hältst dich über neue Technologien und bewährte Engineering-Praktiken auf dem Laufenden, damit unsere Tools und Systeme den geschäftlichen Anforderungen stets einen Schritt voraus sind und unsere Plattform wettbewerbsfähig bleibt.

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit Tools und Technologien rund um Large Language Models (LLMs), darunter Anbieter-APIs wie Anthropic, OpenAI oder Gemini, Agenten- und Tool-Use-Patterns wie MCP sowie die Bewertung der Ausgabequalität.
  • Vertrautheit mit Technologien für die Vektorsuche, beispielsweise pgvector oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse- und Observability-Tools wie PostHog oder Sentry, um die Nutzung zu messen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen zu fördern.
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von ERP- oder operativen Systemen, etwa für Bestellungen, Lagerbestände oder Stammdaten.
  • Beruflicher Hintergrund im E-Commerce, Großhandel oder im Umfeld von B2B-Plattformen.
  • Python-Kenntnisse für die Entwicklung von Datenwerkzeugen sowie Erfahrung mit Docker, GitHub Actions und AWS.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
  • Fünf bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, verbunden mit einem ausgeprägten Produktverständnis.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript und modernen React-Anwendungen. Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Node.js, Express oder vergleichbaren Technologien, REST-APIs sowie PostgreSQL und praktische SQL-Kenntnisse. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung neuer Anwendungen mit unserem modernen Tech-Stack aus React 19, Vite, TypeScript und Bun. Gelegentlich arbeitest du außerdem an einer bestehenden JavaScript-Codebasis.
  • Vertrautheit mit modernen KI-/ML-Frameworks und agentischen KI-Systemen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenmodellierung und im Aufbau skalierbarer Systemarchitekturen.
  • Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten sicher und effektiv zu arbeiten.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI in Produkte, beispielsweise in den Bereichen strukturierte Datenextraktion, Automatisierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) oder agentische Workflows – nicht nur im Umgang mit KI-Programmierassistenten.

  • Proaktive Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Selbstständigkeit und Initiative in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Warum wir?

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz & hochwertige Ausstattung
    • Dich erwartet ein gut ausgestattetes Office mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen, mobilen Laufbändern, Klimaanlage und allem, was du für produktives Arbeiten brauchst.

Jobbeschreibung

Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

HINWEISE:

💡 👉 Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

🇨🇭 Diese Position ist in der Schweiz angesiedelt und richtet sich an Menschen, die vor Ort in der Schweiz leben und arbeiten möchten. Du arbeitest dabei mit einem Remote-Vertrag – flexibel, digital und bestens vernetzt. Da wir auch mit französischsprachigen Kund:innen und Partner:innen arbeiten, freuen wir uns besonders über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse. 💬✨

WAS DU MACHST

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Durchführung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen – inklusive Controlling sowie Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsprüfung.
  • Du koordinierst und steuerst alle beteiligten Stakeholder – von Influencer:innen und Kund:innen über Kreation und Produktion bis hin zum Paid- und Social-Team.
  • Du wirkst gemeinsam mit dem Kreativ-Team an der Entwicklung von Kampagnenkonzepten mit.
  • Du betreust und planst Foto- und Video-Produktionen.

Stellenanforderungen

WAS DU BRAUCHST

    No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.

    Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs.
  • Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung
    Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.
  • Flexibel arbeiten
    „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.
  • Mehr Freizeit
    „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.
  • Health & Wellbeing
    Hot girl walk or heavy lift? Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.
  • Exklusive Deals & Extras
    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:
  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.
  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – 50 € monatlicher Zuschuss zu deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

Außerdem sind unsere Offices dog-friendly. Snacks, Obst und Drinks stehen allen Mates jederzeit kostenlos zur Verfügung.

data.description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.

Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role:

This is a defining leadership role at an exciting stage of CoMind’s growth. You will inherit a talented multidisciplinary engineering team and have the mandate to shape how the hardware function operates — from technical standards and development practices to team structure and long-term capability. You will:

  • Establish best-in-class hardware development processes and quality standards across mechanical, electronics, and opto-mechanical disciplines.

  • Build and develop a high-performing team, identifying capability gaps and creating a bench of talent for future product programmes.

  • Work closely with the Systems Architect, Technical SMEs, and Programme Management to drive delivery across CoMind’s product pipeline.

  • Take translational research outputs through the full development lifecycle into commercial, regulated medical device products.

This role leads the hardware engineering function at CoMind, with responsibility for building and sustaining a high-performing team of mechanical, electronics, and opto-mechanical engineers. As a functional leader, you will own the engineering capability, standards, processes, and tools that underpin CoMind’s medical device development programmes.

Working in close partnership with the System Architects, Technical Subject Matter Experts, and Programme Management, you will ensure the hardware engineering function is resourced, structured, and equipped to deliver across CoMind’s product pipeline. You will set and maintain the technical standards and development processes that govern how the team works, ensuring alignment with medical device regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in medical device product design and development, with hands-on experience across the full development lifecycle. You will combine deep technical credibility with the people and organisational skills needed to influence decisions at both programme and organisational level.

 

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development

    • Lead, mentor, and develop the hardware engineering team — mechanical, electronics, and opto-mechanical engineers — setting high standards of delivery and continuous professional improvement.

    • Identify and address skills gaps across the function; build a bench of talent for future programme needs.

    • Provide direct line management, coaching, and performance development for all direct reports.

    Functional Ownership & Standards

    • Own hardware engineering capability — ensuring the function has the right people, skills, tools, and processes for project delivery.

    • Set and maintain operational, technical, and quality standards. Define and enforce best practices and methodologies; ensure work meets functional quality benchmarks.

    • Lead the appropriate adoption of AI tools and technologies during product development, where they can demonstrably improve quality or velocity.

    • Drive continuous process improvement and stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and methods within the healthcare industry.

    Regulatory Compliance

    • Ensure the engineering team maintains alignment with CoMind’s Quality Management System and medical device regulatory requirements (FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 60601) throughout development.

    Cross-Functional Delivery

    • Work with the Systems Architect, SMEs, and Programme Management to enable effective programme delivery. Structure cross-functional collaboration, resolve technical or resource bottlenecks, and ensure the hardware team delivers against project needs.

    • Take outputs from the translational optical research team and data science team through the development process and into commercial products.

    • Represent the engineering team at product steering meetings and with senior management, customers, and commercial partners as required.

    Strategic Planning

    • Provide strategic and tactical planning input to ensure adequate engineering resources are available to deliver business goals and objectives.

    • Support development from concept through to product realisation, including industrialisation and scale-up.

Skills & Experience:

  • Essential

    • Substantial experience of new product development within a regulated environment, including the medical device industry — with clear progression through the full product lifecycle from concept to commercialisation.

    • At least 5 years in a leadership role within a complex, multidisciplinary product development environment, ideally including medical devices.

    • A track record of delivering complex medical devices incorporating optoelectronic systems, real-time embedded systems, SoCs, and safety-critical components.

    • A rigorous understanding of the application of regulatory standards (FDA, ISO 13485, and IEC 60601) to product lifecycle processes.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

    Technical Experience

    • High-speed mixed-signal analogue and digital electronics

    • Ultra-low noise electronic design

    • Embedded RTOS microcontrollers and microprocessors; safety-critical embedded systems

    • CAD modelling, FEA, tolerance analysis, and material selection

    • IEC and UL safety and compliance standards including EMC

    • PCBA manufacture, test, and qualification within a regulated environment

    • FMEA techniques and reliability / thermal engineering

    • High-speed FPGA design

    • Optical laser interferometry

    • Optical biophysical measurements and signal processing

    • Schematic design and component layout for low-noise electronics

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life assurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

data.description:
Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster.

In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries.

We're now on the hunt for someone truly brilliant to own our socials: making content installers look forward to watching, and turning that attention into customers.

 

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

 

🥖 The role

You'll work closely with Hector and the wider growth team. You'll be our first dedicated social hire. Almost nobody is making great content for installers, so the field is wide open and it's yours to build. Your goal is to make Spruce the account every installer follows. Day-to-day you'll be:

  • Making the content yourself – You'll take each piece from idea to script, shoot, edit and post: installer stories, site visits, founder clips, and new out-of-the-box ideas with a real shot at going viral. You'll have the freedom to try anything, and to bring in freelance editors or videographers when that gets better content out sooner.

  • Getting people on camera – You'll spend time on site with our customers and make installers look brilliant on camera. You'll get our own team on camera too, from sales to the devs who build the product.

  • Getting the mix right – You'll balance videos that entertain (skits, challenges, series), teach installers something useful, build trust through real installer stories, and show what Spruce does, so the account never feels like an advert. You'll keep testing new formats, trends and collabs with installer creators.

  • Owning our socials – You'll run Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook: the voice, what we make, and what goes out and when. You'll do more of what works and drop what doesn't.

  • Building a community – You'll reply to comments and DMs yourself, and build a community of installers who want to be featured: an audience that becomes our customers.

 

🫵 About you

We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft.

You don't need a particular job title or a set number of years, but you do need to show us something you grew: an account, a channel, a series or a brand. You'll ideally be:

  • A proven creator – you've grown an account, you've had videos that travelled well beyond your normal reach, and you can tell us why they worked;

  • Obsessed with what works – you study what's working on TikTok, Reels and Shorts this week (not last year), you have strong opinions about hooks, and you're always learning what's taking off and what's dying;

  • Properly hands-on – you do most of the shooting and editing yourself and you're quick, and you use AI tools to go faster;

  • Comfortable on camera – you're happy being the talking head yourself, and even happier getting a great take out of an installer who's never been filmed;

  • Curious about the numbers – you check how every post did because you want the next one to be better, not because you love a dashboard;

  • Interested in installers – you see small business owners doing technically complex, physically demanding work, with a brilliant story in every one, and you want to understand their world, not just film it.

Bonus points if you've had videos pass a million views or grown an account to 100k+ followers.

… and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

 

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 £40–60k salary, depending on experience

  • 🍰 Equity (options) in the company

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday (25 plus bank holidays) and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover (Vitality)

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

 

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team of 35, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2–3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone together every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it and what we can learn – and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

Role Summary:

From efficiently scaling database operations to supporting the growing amount of data (tens of terabytes), we're looking for engineers that have the creativity and skills to gather meaningful data and insights.

As an engineer at Sensor Tower, you will make sure we're building the best possible products and features to support our users. In our lean and flat organization, you will also have a meaningful say in what and how we build out all aspects of our product.

A Day in the Life:

Interviewee: Engineering Team Lead - Sasha Yelkovenka

 

What does your day to day look like working as a Software Engineer?

I work with tons of data and the volume of this data is constantly increasing. My job is to make sure our customers can access it as quickly as possible and provide them convenient tools for data consumption. I love the spirit of taking ownership of your work and product.

 

How do you collaborate with your team as a remote employee?

Sensor Tower has a great atmosphere of a distributed team. We often pair over zoom to combine our knowledge in order to achieve better results..

What You Will Do

  • Participate in the full development life cycle, including design, implementation, quality polish, and release.

  • Leverage your strengths and interests to work on full feature implementation from brainstorming the architecture design, all the way to the back end implementation and delivery to the customers.

  • Optimize endpoints that touch billions of rows in the database, by applying profiling to ruby code and understanding crucial performance details of ClickHouse queries.

  • Perform code reviews, and suggest improvements to tools and processes.

  • Work on challenging products like Top Apps, where each query basically analyzes the whole dataset.

  • Design API contracts that other teams can rely on, and evolve them without breaking existing consumers.

  • Be the go-to partner for front-end, product, data science and customer-facing teams building on these APIs. Understand what they need, push back when a request would make the API harder to reason about, and turn recurring questions into better docs.

Experience We Want To See

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer (If you have lesser years of experience but have meaningful github contributions and other coding samples, this will be taken into consideration).

  • Strong foundation in programming, algorithms, and software application design.

  • Good API design for query-heavy, data-intensive APIs.

  • You have an understanding of the basics of cloud environments, and ideally you’ve had some exposure to AWS.

  • Required: Ruby on Rails (or Python and willing to learn Ruby on Rails).

  • Nice to have: Clickhouse, MongoDB, Sidekiq.

  • A track record of independently driving projects from ambiguous requirements to release.

Our Engineering Culture

We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values:

- Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys."

- Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping.

- Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids.

- Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent.

Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team):

https://sensortower.com/blog/speeding-up-the-backend-with-graph-theory

https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers

Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About Frontier

Faculty Frontier™ is a decision operating system. It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act.

Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business.

Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. Teams simulate and optimise options with ADA, our AI decision agent, and every decision is tracked against its outcome so the system keeps learning. Our ambition is to make business decisions as easy to navigate as getting around a city.

We don’t believe in AI that thinks for people. We believe in AI that helps people think, with humans and agents working together inside a decision system.

Customers start with one high-value decision and prove value in weeks. Over months they connect it into a wider decision network, and over years they build an adaptive enterprise.

Frontier is built by Faculty, an AI company that has delivered more than 400 systems since 2014 and is now part of Accenture.

About the role

As a Senior Manager at Faculty, you will shape our clients’ transformation journeys, ensuring our Frontier product capabilities translate into real-world business impact. Operating at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical delivery, you will guide enterprise customers from greenfield discovery through to scalable implementation. You will build trusted relationships across senior stakeholders and strategic partners like Accenture and AWS, uncovering new opportunities to grow accounts, craft compelling value propositions, and deliver lasting value across the business.

What you'll be doing:

  • Shaping new business opportunities by onboarding quickly to new client contexts, running stakeholder workshops, crafting compelling proposals with appropriate pricing, and balancing commercial potential against delivery risk.

  • Developing robust business cases and strategic account roadmaps that articulate long-term value and drive further adoption of Frontier across client organisations.

  • Leading lighthouse implementations and pilots—guiding customers from greenfield problems through to structured requirements, viable roadmaps, and accelerated time-to-value.

  • Building trusted, multi-level relationships across accounts—engaging senior sponsors, business owners, and end users while acting as a customer advocate within Faculty.

  • Collaborating with our Product team to translate user needs into repeatable industry solutions that scale alongside key partners like Accenture and AWS.

  • Packaging customer value stories and proposition narratives to showcase our impact, strengthen new business collateral, and engage senior leadership to close sales.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring proven experience leading technically complex projects for enterprise customers, knowing how to bring structure to ambiguity and execute effectively through others.

  • You’re commercially astute, with strong intuition for customer expectations and a track record of scoping, costing, and winning new business proposals with limited oversight.

  • You have a strong product mindset and technical aptitude—able to quickly grasp technical capabilities, direct technical teams, and map user needs to Frontier features.

  • You’re a skilled relationship builder who communicates persuasively in writing and in person. You are equally comfortable crafting a compelling vision for a CEO as you are distilling detailed points for a technical stakeholder

  • You possess an entrepreneurial, self-starting approach, spotting opportunities to grow accounts and developing compelling business cases that clearly articulate customer value.

  • You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments, aligning cross-functional teams and external partners to drive shared success.

Our Interview Process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Hiring Manager introduction (45 mins)

  3. Live Case Study Interview (90 mins)

  4. Meet the team (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

What you'll be doing:

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple facets of the Defence enterprise, ensuring alignment with departmental strategic objectives.

  • Developing and owning compelling, mission-focused proposals to grow our Defence and National Security portfolio.

  • Working strategically to deliver meaningful operational outcomes and improved decision-making for Defence organisations rather than just focusing on outputs.

  • Forming strong, trusted relationships with senior military and civilian customers, collaborating closely with other industry partners where required.

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, engaging confidently in complex technical discussions with senior leaders and directors.

  • Supporting wider business efforts as a Senior Manager to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact across the business unit.

Who we're looking for:

  • You are an experienced Senior Manager with a proven background in managing complex, large-scale transformation programmes within demanding environments.

  • You bring significant experience in the Defence space, possibly gained through a career in the Armed Forces, Government, academia, or industry roles.

  • You have a track record of shipping digital products and possess the expertise required to get AI-enabled services over the line within a Government or Defence context.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. Wordsmith

Our customers are some of the most demanding enterprise legal departments in the world, and they hold us to a high bar on security, privacy, and responsible AI.

We're looking for a senior leader to take ownership of security and compliance as we scale.

The Role

GRC Leads own security and compliance at Wordsmith end-to-end — setting the strategy for IT and infrastructure security, running our certification program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001, embedding responsible-AI practices into how we build and ship product, and making sure privacy and regulatory obligations (GDPR and beyond) are handled properly as we grow.

This is a senior role that blends strategy and hands-on execution. You'll set multi-year direction, represent Wordsmith's security posture to executives, customers, and — as we grow — the board, and build the team, tooling, and controls the company needs at the next stage, not just maintain what exists today.

What You'll Do

Security Strategy & Leadership

  • Own Wordsmith's multi-year IT security and compliance roadmap — setting priorities, budget, and tooling decisions in partnership with Engineering and company leadership.

IT & Infrastructure Security

  • Own security architecture across corporate IT and infrastructure — identity & access management, endpoint protection, and cloud/network security — and lead incident response when issues arise.

Compliance & Certification

  • Own SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27017/27018, and ISO 42001 end-to-end — policies, controls, audit evidence, and the audits themselves.

AI Governance

  • Run our AI governance program, including AI Impact Assessments and model/AI-vendor risk reviews, ensuring responsible, compliant AI use across the product.

Privacy Operations

  • Own privacy operations end-to-end — GDPR and other regulatory obligations, DPIAs, RoPA maintenance, sub-processor management, and Data Subject Request fulfilment.

Third-Party & Vendor Risk

  • Assess vendors and AI tools for security, privacy, and AI risk before they're adopted, and put the right contractual safeguards in place at a program level.

Team & Function Building

  • Build the people, process, and tooling the function needs as it scales — starting as the senior owner of the program today, with a mandate to build out a team as Wordsmith grows.

Executive & Board Reporting

  • Own risk and compliance reporting to leadership and, as we scale, the board — translating technical risk into business terms.

Customer & Deal Support

  • Act as the senior voice on security for enterprise deals — security questionnaires, DPAs, and our Trust Center — partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Legal to unblock deals without cutting corners.

Automation & Tooling

  • Build lean, automation-first tooling (e.g. Vanta) for evidence collection and ongoing compliance monitoring, so the program scales without scaling headcount unnecessarily.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 8-10+ years in security, IT, or compliance roles, including a track record of owning a security or compliance function end-to-end at a fast-growing SaaS or tech company.

  • Proven experience building or scaling a security/compliance program from an early stage — ideally including time as the sole or founding owner of the function.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 series, and ideally ISO 42001.

  • Strong grounding in core IT security fundamentals — identity & access management, endpoint/device security, and cloud or network infrastructure security.

  • Practical, working knowledge of GDPR and related privacy regulation (ePrivacy or similar).

  • Experience presenting security posture, risk, and roadmap to executives, boards, or investors.

  • Experience building and/or managing a team — or a clear point of view on how you'd grow one as the function scales.

  • Comfortable owning budget and vendor decisions at a strategic level, not just executing against someone else's plan.

  • A strong cross-functional operator and executive communicator, bridging Security, IT, Legal/Privacy, Engineering, and GTM.

Valued

  • Prior experience as a Head of Security, Director of Security/IT, or similar senior/leadership title.

  • Relevant certifications — e.g. CISSP/ISC2, CISM, AIGP, CIPP/E, CIPT, CCSK, or FIP.

  • Experience in legal tech, AI, or another highly regulated SaaS environment.

  • Experience designing AI risk or impact-assessment processes from scratch.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Datagrail, MineOS, Whistic, or SafeBase.

Why this role matters

You'll take a senior leadership seat over security and compliance, with real ownership over how the function is shaped and grown.

You'll sit at the centre of trust for a fast-growing legal AI platform, directly enabling enterprise sales and customer confidence.

You'll have a clear path to building and leading a team as the function scales with the company.

What you can expect

A small, focused leadership group where your work has visible, immediate impact.

Competitive compensation, benefits, and meaningful equity.

How we work

We're an in-office team in Edinburgh. We work together because it helps us collaborate closely across product, engineering, and legal teams. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

This is a high ownership role. You'll be trusted to set strategy, represent security to executives and customers, and drive outcomes without heavy oversight.

Group Data Protection Officer | M-KOPA

Remote (covering Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa and the UK)

You're the lawyer people call when a data question has no easy answer. You're accomplished. You're respected. You're probably even happy. But is your work protecting millions of people who are trusting a formal financial service with their personal information for the very first time?

That is the question at the heart of this role.

The trust you'd be protecting

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers, up from 5 million in 2024, and has unlocked $2+ billion in credit. 86% of our customers report an improved quality of life, 70% use our products to earn an income, and 55% are accessing products and services for the first time. Behind them stand 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents. Every one of those customers has handed us personal information, and they did it because they believed we would handle it with care. Across Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Uganda and the UK, that belief is held under six different sets of rules, each with its own expectations about consent, retention, cross-border transfers and what happens when something goes wrong. The customers who benefit most from what we build are often the ones with the least room to absorb a mistake with their data, and that is the standard this role exists to hold.

Why this timing matters

You may have seen us advertising several roles across Legal, Risk and Compliance. That is deliberate, not random. We've moved from 5 million customers to 7 million, and we are now building beyond 10 million. The legal, risk and privacy foundations have to be laid ahead of that growth, not scrambled together after it. New markets, new products and new partners all arrive with new data questions. Joining now means shaping the privacy programme while its biggest chapters are still ahead of it.

What makes this different

In many organisations, the data protection officer reviews things at the end of the process. Here, the role reaches the whole group. Your current role: one jurisdiction, one regime. This role: six markets, one customer promise.

You would report day to day to the Chief Legal, Risk and Compliance Officer, with reporting to the CEO and the Board as well. Your recommendations on strategy and implementation go to the people who run the company, and they shape how the business executes. Your work also connects directly to our mission. Financial inclusion only works if the people we serve can trust us with what they share, and you would be one of the people who keeps that trust earned. Because the role spans the whole group, you would also see patterns that no single market team can: where the same gap appears in several places, and where one fix can protect every customer at once.

What you'll bring

  • Qualified lawyer with extensive, progressive experience in data protection and privacy compliance, including running privacy operations end to end: data protection impact assessments, transfer impact assessments, vendor assessments and risk management.

  • Detailed command of data protection law across our six markets, paired with a sound understanding of information systems, data processing operations and security needs, so you can challenge the architecture as confidently as the contract.

  • Demonstrable experience developing policies, guidelines and template clauses for the processing of personal data, and proficiency in using AI tools responsibly to support privacy research, compliance work and risk assessment.

A recognised privacy or security certification (CIPP, CIPT, or ISO 27001 or 27701 implementer or auditor) is an added advantage. It is not a gate.

What you'll actually do

  • Run the programme and fix what you find. Lead remediation and data audits, conduct DPIAs, identify where we are partially or fully non-compliant, and put it right across all six markets, while keeping the records of processing that prove it.

  • Build the tools everyone else uses. Write the guidelines, template clauses and contracts that govern how partners, suppliers and vendors handle personal information, and support the privacy software, incident response and breach notification procedures behind them.

  • Turn the law into culture. Design training and internal communications for staff, run awareness for third parties, and support due diligence, certification, audits and new-market expansion, so data protection is something every team does rather than something Legal does to them.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will hold six regimes in your head at once, advise colleagues who would rather hear a different answer, and move a business forward with clear, plain-English advice. It is an onsite role, and your calendar will hold the strategic and the urgent in the same week: a policy redesign on Monday, a vendor assessment on Wednesday, a breach notification drill on Friday. The work rewards people who like building systems that still work when nobody is watching. You're probably ready for exactly this.

Ready to build the privacy standard 10 million customers can rely on?

If you read the question at the top of this page and felt something, that is probably the signal. Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

LOCATION: London, UK preferred. US & EU candidates will be considered. then US, then EU.

Option A: £400-500/day ~2.5 days/week, contract.
Option B: £120,000 base, full-time.

We are open to two profiles:

  • Head of Security (part-time contract, ~2.5 days/week): an information security lead covering the full scope below.

  • Head of Security & Security Engineer (full-time): the same scope, plus hands-on technical security engineering. This is highlighted in the additional engineering scope below.

Please tell us in your application which you are applying for and what your availability and notice period are.

About

The AI Whistleblower Initiative (https://aiwi.org) is an independent non-profit supporting frontier AI insiders who want to raise concerns. We do this through outreach and education of insiders, access to vetted legal and financial resources, and policy work. Our insights help strengthen internal and government reporting channels, advocate for better legislation, and promote the conditions under which concerns can reach the people best placed to act on them, with source protection at their core. Find a selection of our work here (https://aiwi.org/our-work).

Most high-stakes moments in AI over the coming years will involve frontier company insiders having and raising concerns: within companies, to regulators, or through other pathways.

Those insiders tell us they face enormous uncertainty along the “concern raising” path -- from detecting concerns to whether and how to voice concerns with maximum impact and minimal risk, which even legally protected whistleblowing can carry. To date, no organization has dedicated itself deeply to delivering the best strategic, frontier-AI-specific guidance to these individuals, their supporters, and their attorneys (our partners). We exist to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure.

Tasks

About the role

The Head of Security is a dual inward- and outward-facing role. You will update, design and implement AIWI’s internal security posture, and provide external guidance to AI insiders, whistleblowers and partners. You will create and oversee internal security controls, manage an evolving risk appetite, and design internal policies and trainings so that staff stay safe and secure in their everyday workflows. You will also design and deliver training and guidance to would-be whistleblowers and AIWI’s partners.

In other words, you are as comfortable drafting an internal security policy or building an onboarding and device-provisioning plan as you are training whistleblowers on how to evade insider-threat-management (ITM) systems, or explaining natural language watermarking. You can design, implement, and enforce a coherent data governance policy, and you understand the intricacies of watermarking schemes and counter-forensic measures against them.

You will report to Karl Koch, our CEO, and work closely with our co-founder/technical advisor Max and the principal engineer we are hiring. You will manage potential contractors and propose spend, with CEO sign-off on budget. Our environment is highly sensitive: so confidentiality, careful judgement, and conviction in what we do are essential.

Areas of Ownership

1. Internal security and compliance.

  • Onboarding, access rights, information sharing

  • Working with trustworthy contractors

  • Tooling: audit of all tool configurations, and keeping critical software (e.g., our GlobaLeaks instance) up to date

  • Incident policy and response

  • Security input and strategy on new technology and developments

  • Full review of the current setup, identifying vulnerabilities to inform wider strategy and next steps

  • IT helpdesking (supporting Operations to field the right ones your way)

2. External: insiders and coalition members.

  • Guidance, video content, and op-eds

  • Assisting coalition members

  • Device provisioning

  • Being “ready” to urgently support security needs

  • Further services/offerings

3. Security engineering (full-time track only).

  • You will build and run the technical security layer behind AIWI’s internal and external systems, working alongside the Principal Engineer (e.g. Harden and monitor our self-hosted, set up; Build security tooling, automation, and detections in-house; Review architecture and code, and secure CI/CD and the software supply chain; Run offensive testing (pen tests, red teaming) on our own systems and tools, including our GlobaLeaks instance; Lead technical incident response and forensics; Take security engineering work off the Principal Engineer so they can focus on product delivery)

Requirements

Core (both profiles)

  • Experience working with and securing journalists, sources, whistleblowers, or others in high-risk sensitive environments.

  • Proven track record of delivering security trainings to diverse audiences in a variety of environments.

  • Demonstrated experience in source protection (how have you helped journalists or non-profits safeguard sources?).

  • Deep knowledge of secure platforms (e.g., able to explain the security differences between Signal and SimpleX, or between Qubes and Tails).

  • Proficiency in operational security, threat modeling, and risk management.

  • Familiarity with IDS, ITM, and DLP suites, and how to safeguard whistleblowers against these systems.

  • Experience drafting, enacting, and enforcing internal security controls and policies.

  • Knowledge of document, audio, and video watermarking systems, and counter-forensics.

  • Genuine, demonstrable commitment to AI safety and whistleblower protection.

  • 5-15 years experience, dependent on the projects you have worked on.

Additional for the full-time profile

  • Hands-on experience as a security engineer or builder, with a track record of shipping security tooling and infrastructure.

  • Strong coding skills in one or more of Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++, plus shell. You write security tooling, automation, and detections yourself, without relying on AI tools.

  • Offensive security experience (penetration testing, red teaming, exploit understanding). You can think and operate like an attacker.

  • Infrastructure security: Linux hardening, network segmentation, cloud and self-hosted setups, IaC (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.).

  • Application security: secure code review, OWASP Top 10, supply-chain security, secrets management.

  • Detection and response: logging, SIEM/IDS, forensics, incident handling.

Benefits

Package for full-time

  • £120,000 base

  • Up to 9% on UEL pension contribution

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public bank holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development budget

  • A home office or equipment stipend for hybrid staff

  • Wellness budget

  • Paid for co-working space in London/SF

  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Why join?

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes.

  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1.

  • Chance to define your personal career development.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

 

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

 

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You'll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

  • Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

We're excited about you because…

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent
