About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The role

As our MI Analyst, you will tell our Contact Centre leaders what the data means and what to do about it, then build the tools that deliver it at scale. You will sit in the Workforce Planning team, working across all teams who deal with customer contacts and report to the Head of Workforce Planning. Each day, week and month we publish reporting on agent productivity, operational performance and business review data across multiple teams and two sites. The job is to go beyond filling in the numbers and answer the "so what":

  • What are our most immediate opportunities?

  • What do we do about them with operational leaders?

  • Where are we losing efficiency?

  • Where could the same hours deliver more?

You will also use AI to do this faster than any manual process could. We run Claude connected to our BI data lake, so the right person can pull data, build reports and automate repeatable work themselves, without waiting in a queue. We want someone who sees that and immediately starts asking what they can automate.

What you will do

Find the insight

  • Turn Contact Centre data into clear findings and recommendations, and tell leaders what to do, not just what happened.

  • Spot where we are losing efficiency or capacity, size each opportunity, and prioritise the ones worth acting on.

  • Add commentary to the reports you publish, so readers see the story behind the numbers.

  • Own our understanding of contact drivers: explain why customers contact us, how that is changing, and what we could do to reduce it or handle it better.

Build with AI, at scale

  • Use Claude and our BI data lake to pull data, build reports and automate manual collation.

  • Replace repeatable, manual reporting with automated, reliable processes, so your time goes on analysis.

  • Bring us ideas for what to automate next, and show the time and capacity you save.

  • Document what you build so others in the team can run and maintain it when required.

Run the reporting cadence

  • Deliver daily, weekly and monthly reporting on agent productivity, utilisation and key service metrics across phone, email, chat and messaging.

  • Prepare the data for our daily, weekly and monthly business reviews (WBR and MBR).

  • Keep stakeholders updated on what you are working on and when it will land, without being asked.

Own accuracy

  • Validate every output before you share it. You are the last line of quality control on your own work.

  • Check sources and definitions rather than trusting historical reports, and flag anything that looks wrong before others find it.

  • Cross check your reports against the WBR and other sources, so mismatches show up before stakeholders spot them.

Be our Contact Centre data partner to BI

  • Act as the Contact Centre data partner to our BI teams, and the link between them and our operational leaders.

  • Help validate data models, dashboards and metrics against what is really happening on the floor.

  • Spot data issues early, raise them with BI with clear examples, and see them through to a fix.

  • Turn operational questions into clear requirements for BI, and help test what they build before it goes live.

  • Keep metric definitions consistent across Zendesk, Talkdesk, Calabrio and Looker.

Work with the business

  • Understand what team leaders and managers need from the data, and challenge whether our metrics are the right ones.

  • Help define and evolve Contact Centre KPIs as the business grows.

  • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting on test and learn initiatives, and on BPO partner performance.

What we are looking for

We want someone who has already worked with data in a busy operation and wants to do much more with it. If you are curious, thorough and keen to build, we want to hear from you.

You will need

  • Real curiosity about data. You ask why a number moved, not just what it is.

  • The ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation that a non-technical leader can act on.

  • Strong attention to detail, and the habit of sense checking your own work before anyone else sees it.

  • Experience as an analyst, with a real understanding of the data you work with: where it comes from, how it is built, and what it can and cannot tell you.

  • Hands on experience using AI tools such as Claude to analyse data or build things, or a strong track record of picking up new tools fast.

  • Strong written and spoken communication, including working with BI teams to validate data and proactively updating stakeholders on progress and delays.

  • A drive to take ownership, without being prompted, of the reports and processes you run.

  • The ability to manage daily and weekly deadlines in a fast moving operation.

It would be great if you have

  • Experience in a Contact Centre or operations environment, and working knowledge of how AHT, occupancy, SLA and productivity are measured and what moves them.

  • Experience with BigQuery, dbt, Looker Studio or similar BI tools.

  • Experience with Zendesk, Talkdesk or Calabrio data.

  • Examples of something you automated or built that saved real time.

Why join us

  • Claude connected to our BI data lake, so you can build with real, live data from day one.

  • Your work is used every morning by operational leaders to run the day and directly impacts business performance.

  • Room to move from running reports to owning our Ops reporting automation.

  • A small team where good ideas get picked up and shipped.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • £34,000 per annum

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

  • 33 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

Equal Opportunities Statement

Motorway is committed to equality of opportunity for all employees. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximise their full potential. We believe our workforce should reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.

We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our New Products & Geographies Engineering team in London. This team launches and scales new lending propositions in two directions: bringing Abound’s lending to customers in new countries and expanding our B2B offering for partners. We move quickly, exploring ideas through production-ready MVPs and iterating as products mature.

This is a hybrid role, with at least three days a week in our London office. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship. We value engineers who are curious about the business and are keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and customer experience.

Our technology stack

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy and Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker and AWS.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested Python, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Work closely with our React frontend developers to build the APIs and backend logic their features rely on

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

Who you are:

You’ll need:

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Python – you don’t need to be an expert, but you’re comfortable writing, testing and debugging code

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and unit testing

  • Familiarity with SQL, relational databases and Git

  • To be able to work from our London office at least three days a week

You’ll do well here if you:

  • Have a sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • Learn quickly, take initiative and work methodically through problems, even in a large, evolving codebase

  • Communicate clearly, ask questions, take on feedback and work well in a team

  • Have a genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

Ideally you'll also have:

  • Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI

  • Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker

  • Knowledge of lending products or open banking

How we work:

To be successful here, our culture needs to energies you. Here’s how we operate:

  • High bar and real ownership: We’re a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • Focus on impact: We measure success by what we deliver to customers. We prioritise carefully so our energy goes where it makes the biggest difference.

  • MVP and iteration culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One team collaboration: We collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations and the wider business.

  • Thrive in change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgement, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

We’re hiring a Security Engineering Lead to build and lead our security engineering team, reporting to the Head of Platform.

You’ll manage engineers working across product and platform security, set a clear direction for the function and help us grow our product security capability. You’ll join a small team with both specialisms already represented and shape how it develops.

Our product security engineers work alongside Product Engineering teams, contributing to planning, design, code and delivery. They report to you for technical development, performance and career progression. You’ll stay close enough to their work to support them well, even when you are not part of their day-to-day team.

You’ll bring experience as a security engineer and as a people manager. You should be able to challenge a design, reason through a threat model and help an engineer find a practical solution. You’ll also need to make choices about where we invest, build relationships across engineering and explain security priorities in terms of customer and business risk.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our product and platform security engineers through regular feedback, coaching, clear expectations and fair performance assessment.

  • Build a focused security engineering strategy and roadmap, informed by our products, engineering plans and the risks that matter most.

  • Grow the team thoughtfully, identifying capability gaps and taking responsibility for hiring and onboarding.

  • Agree sustained product security placements with engineering leaders, with clear priorities, useful feedback and a strong connection to the security team.

  • Help teams build security into architecture and implementation, including access control, tenant isolation, confidential data handling and AI systems.

  • Work with Platform Engineering to make secure infrastructure and delivery practices easy to adopt, using shared controls and automation where they help.

  • Stay involved in important technical decisions through design and code reviews, investigations and selective implementation.

  • Help engineers raise concerns and resolve disagreements constructively. Make material risks and trade-offs clear to the leaders accountable for the decision.

  • Partner with IT and Information Security on shared risks, incident response and assurance requirements.

  • Measure whether our approach reduces meaningful risk and helps engineers deliver securely. Use what we learn to improve it.


What we’re looking for

  • A background in hands-on security engineering, with strong product or application security experience.

  • Demonstrated line management experience: developing engineers, giving difficult feedback, assessing performance and supporting career progression.

  • Experience supporting engineers whose daily work happens within other teams, or comparable evidence of managing effectively without observing all their work directly.

  • Current technical judgement across secure software design, threat modelling, authentication, authorisation and protection of sensitive data.

  • Enough cloud and platform security breadth to guide specialists and make sound decisions across both areas.

  • Experience setting priorities and securing support for security improvements across engineering teams.

  • The ability to explain risk clearly, offer workable options and make proportionate recommendations under uncertainty.

  • A collaborative approach that helps product and platform engineers own the security of the systems they build.

Useful experience

  • Working with AWS, backend services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

  • Securing multi-tenant products, confidential customer data or AI-enabled systems.

  • Building or improving a small security engineering team in a growing organisation.

What success looks like

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Customer Success at Duffel

Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.

The Role

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer: the technical expert who helps customers design the right Duffel solution during the sales process, then guides them through building it until they go live.

In pre-sales, you'll join our Account Executives on discovery calls and pitches, bringing the technical depth to understand how a customer's product works and design how Duffel fits into it. Once the deal is signed, you'll take that design into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact, making sure they go live smoothly with the best setup for their use case.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success. You'll be our first Solutions Engineer, so the way you do this job will become how the team works as it grows. That could lead to managing a team of solutions engineers, or to a principal-level technical role shaping how our largest customers build on Duffel. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Join Account Executives on discovery calls, pitches and technical deep-dives, running technical discovery on the customer's product, architecture, user journeys and travel use case.

  • Design the solution, build demos and proofs of concept, and write solution designs and implementation scopes so customers know what they're building before they sign. Answer technical questions in RFPs and security reviews.

  • Take what you designed into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact: answer their engineers' questions, review integrations, define test plans and run go-live readiness checks.

  • Debug integration issues hands-on with Postman or curl and our API logs, working alongside the Senior Implementation Project Manager, who owns the project plan and dates.

  • Feed integration friction back to Product and Engineering, build reusable assets such as solution templates, sample code and demo apps, and define how pre-sales and implementation run at Duffel.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineer, sales engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager, at an API-first company.

  • Experience on both sides of the contract: supporting sales with discovery, demos and solution design, then implementing what was sold and taking enterprise customers live on complex integrations.

  • Hands-on API skills (REST, JSON, webhooks, authentication, sandbox vs production) and enough coding in a language such as JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby or Java to build a demo and spot what's wrong in a customer's integration.

  • The ability to explain a solution clearly to engineers and commercial decision-makers in the same meeting, and sound judgement on when to push back on a custom request or bring in Product.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in payments, fintech or travel tech, writing statements of work, SQL or AI-assisted development tools is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: demoing Duffel's core flows end to end, building a test integration yourself, joining live sales calls and taking technical ownership of implementations already in flight.

  • By 90 days: leading technical discovery on new opportunities, with a written solution design before signature on every deal you work on.

  • Shaping how new Duffel products, such as Trains and our AI travel agent, are scoped and implemented for customers.

  • In your first year: customers designed in pre-sales going live faster with fewer surprises, a library of reusable solution templates and demo assets, and an evidence-based view of how the function should scale.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption)

The Details

📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays).

🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent:

  1. Talent Partner Screen

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Stage Interview

We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.

We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team.

You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live.

Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings.

  • Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status.

  • Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips.

  • Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team.

  • Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once.

  • Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code.

  • Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner.

  • Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership.

  • By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured.

  • Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts.

  • In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption)

The Details

📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays).

🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent:

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.

  • Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe.

L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés :

  • Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans).

  • Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie).

Au sein de l'équipe Customer Care (Service Client), votre objectif est de maximiser la satisfaction client. Vous êtes le point de contact principal des clients tout au long de leur parcours, depuis le jour de leur réservation jusqu'au remboursement de leur dépôt de garantie après leur départ. Vous assistez les clients pour l'ensemble de leurs problématiques, qu'elles soient administratives ou financières, y compris pour la maintenance de leur appartement. La maîtrise des langues est essentielle, car une part importante de nos clients est internationale. La majorité de l'équipe est basée à Lyon, à l'exception d'une personne basée à Paris, et nous opérons à distance sur l'ensemble de nos villes en France.

Vos missions :

  • Gérer la relation et accompagner le client à distance via Zendesk tout au long de son expérience de coliving, de l'entrée à la sortie du logement : rédaction du bail, vérification des documents, organisation des états des lieux d'entrée (check-in) et de sortie (check-out), comparaison des états des lieux, remboursement des dépôts de garantie.

  • Créer le dossier client numérique et le mettre à jour tout au long de son parcours.

  • Gérer à distance les conflits entre colivers (colocataires) et les litiges clients, dans le meilleur intérêt de l'entreprise et du client.

  • Recouvrer les impayés de loyers et les différents frais auprès des clients par e-mail et par téléphone.

  • Résoudre les problèmes techniques (paiement, accès au compte client, etc.) rencontrés par le client en mobilisant les ressources de l'entreprise.

  • Qualifier, transmettre et suivre en interne l'exécution des interventions techniques dans les appartements, et en informer le client. Assurer le suivi auprès des locataires concernant les interventions en cours ou à venir.

  • Qualifier et répondre aux différents besoins et demandes des clients par e-mail, chat ou WhatsApp, dans les délais définis par l'entreprise.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des pratiques et processus de Customer Happiness afin d'accroître la satisfaction client et d'optimiser les coûts opérationnels des logements en coliving : remonter les bugs à l'équipe technique, améliorer les flux de travail (workflows), numériser les processus, etc.


Ton profil se distingue par :

  • Tu es un(e) communicant(e) hors pair. Tu sais allier empathie, clarté et fermeté pour instaurer un climat de confiance tout en défendant les intérêts de Joivy et de ses partenaires.

Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard
  • Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room
  • Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery
  • Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand
  • Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products

Requirements

Two things matter most:

Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type.

Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company.

Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus.

we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

- A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation

- A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it

What you are not

- A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks

- A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs

- A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for

- The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business

- A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you

- A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

- Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision

- Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts

- Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones

- Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad

- Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams

Within 12 months you will have

- Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal

- Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention

- Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch

- Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments

What's in it for you?

- A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders

- Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals

- A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action

- Opportunity to shape our company's direction

- Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales

Preferred experience

Must have

- You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred.

- You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies.

- You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup.

- You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end.

- You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution.

- You have strong communication skills.

- You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking.

- You have a strong pragmatism.

- You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms.

- You have a strong business acumen.

Nice to have

- You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews).

- You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams.

- You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience.

- You know how to wireframe designs.

- You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong.

- You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff.

Additional Information

- Competitive salary + profit sharing

- Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

- Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits

At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

The role

Context

This new role comes as our customer base grows rapidly, driven in particular by deployments in private healthcare facilities. Its purpose is to ensure our customers get the most out of our solution and are fully satisfied with it.

As Lead Customer Success, you will own customer usage and satisfaction, and manage our Customer Support team of two experienced people. This is a hands-on Lead role: you will manage the team while still spending a significant share of your time working directly on accounts. You will work closely with Clémentine (Head of Ops), the Deployment Strategists, the Product team, and RevOps.

  • Account monitoring: track usage metrics for each hospital and define the indicators to watch.

  • Detection and resolution: spot accounts in trouble (for example a hospital whose activity suddenly drops), raise the alarm and solve the issue, on your own or with the Deployment Strategists.

  • Satisfaction: set up and follow NPS campaigns.

  • Adoption: run campaigns to increase usage of Parallel across our customers.

  • Product feedback: share what you see in the field and work with Product on levers to increase usage.

  • Management: manage two experienced people, set the framework and priorities, help them grow and structure the team as the number of accounts increases.

Who you are

  • You have 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, with your own B2B customer portfolio.

  • You have already set up NPS campaigns and done account monitoring: you know which indicators you track and how you detect an account in trouble.

  • You make decisions on your own on an account and raise the alarm when a metric drops.

  • You want to keep working directly on accounts on top of managing: this is not a pure management role.

  • A plus: experience with key account portfolios.

We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both.

  • Real traction: seed and Series A ($20M with Index Ventures) closed in less than a year, more than 800 clients and a team of over 30 people.

  • Strong investors and founders: Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI; founders who come from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo.

  • Our office: Paris 2nd arrondissement.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès.

  • Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques.

  • Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE ROLE

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation.
Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection
  • Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes
  • Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes
  • Assurer le sourcing matière
  • Établir les fiches de lancement et suivre les corrections de prototypes
  • Réaliser les dessins techniques
  • Participer aux essayages
  • Accompagner les pièces jusqu'à la normalisation, en lien avec les usines
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL

Vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'environ 2 ans en tant que designer junior, idéalement sur le jersey et/ou le flou.

Vous avez également :

  • Une sensibilité forte pour le bien aller du vêtement, avec un attrait pour le flou et le travail en 3D
  • La maîtrise de la suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et une aisance en dessin technique
  • Un esprit autonome, débrouillard et force de proposition
  • La capacité à prendre rapidement des automatismes et à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle
  • L'envie d'évoluer au sein d'un studio créatif exigeant

Présentation de Theodo

Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.

Tes missions

Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.

1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie

  • Participer à la définition des priorités stratégiques de Theodo France à 12 mois, en lien avec Noémie Parker et les équipes de direction.

  • Analyser les leviers de croissance, les enjeux de performance et les opportunités de développement.

  • Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.

  • Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.

2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel

  • Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.

  • Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.

  • Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.

  • Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.

  • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

  • Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.

4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle

  • Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.

  • Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.

  • Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.

  • Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.

  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

🚲Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition.

Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !

🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.

🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).

Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22)

Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.

Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.

 

✏️Tes rôles :

– Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc

– Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)

– Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central

– Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test

– Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement

– Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service

Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose

Ce que l’on te met à disposition :

  • Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents

  • Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés


👉Et si c’était toi ?

– Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués

– Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes

– Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur

– Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement

– Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins)

– Curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), à l’aise en laboratoire

L’entreprise et le projet te plaisent ?

« il ne faut jamais remettre au lendemain ce qu'on peut faire le jour-même » : Tu n’es pas arrivé.e jusqu’ici pour postuler « plus tard » ! C’est rapide, ça prend 2 minutes (et c’est vrai !)

At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The Role

Brevo is transforming all of its operations to become AI native: We are redefining the way we work internally, the way we consume data (analytical and operational), the way we interact with each other.
From customer support teams to RevOps, from Analytical engineer to finance team, all our jobs will be transformed and we becoming manages of agents. The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed.
We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code.
This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production.

Why join us ?

  • A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture.
  • A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other
  • Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production.

Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Design, build, and operate AI agents in production.
  • Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering).
  • Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform.
  • Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction)
  • Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability.
  • Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them.
  • Mentor and grow the engineers on the team

    • Who you are:
    Must-have:
  • Proven tech lead experience: you've set the technical direction for a team, made architecture calls, and mentored engineers.
  • Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same.
  • DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies).
  • Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation.
  • You build with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and push the team to do the same.
  • Fluent in French and English.

    • Nice to have:

  • ADK v2 (Google Agent Development Kit) and the A2A protocol.

  • Langfuse or an equivalent LLM observability tool.

  • LLM cost optimization at scale (caching, routing, model selection).


    • Our candidate journey:
  • 30 min call with Talent Acquisition
  • Vision & systems interview with the Chief Data and AI Officer
  • Technical assessment
  • Team meet-and-greet

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

Joining Novaspace means becoming part of a fast-growing international consulting group specializing in the space sector. Novaspace is currently hiring a Web Engineer to support the development and continuous improvement of its digital platforms, websites, and web-based products. 

As part of the Digital and Data team, the Web Engineer will contribute to Novaspace’s digital activities by developing and maintaining WordPress and WooCommerce websites, custom PHP solutions, React interfaces, and API integrations. 


Responsibilities
  • Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress and WooCommerce websites
  • Build custom PHP features, themes, plugins, and backend functionality
  • Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
  • Integrate third-party services, payment solutions, and internal systems through APIs
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve website performance, security, reliability, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Collaborate with the Digital and Data team, designers, and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions
  • Test, document, deploy, and maintain web solutions while ensuring code quality and timely delivery

    • Desired Skills and Experience
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong experience in WordPress development, including custom themes, plugins, and website maintenance
  • Proven experience developing and customizing WooCommerce websites and e-commerce functionality
  • Strong knowledge of PHP and experience developing custom PHP solutions
  • Experience building responsive web interfaces using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
  • Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and third-party services
  • Good knowledge of MySQL or another relational database
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Understanding of web security, performance optimization, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills
  • Ability to manage priorities, work independently, and deliver projects within agreed deadlines

    • Additional assets
  • Experience with website hosting, deployment, migration, and server environments
  • Familiarity with search engine optimization and web accessibility best practice
  • Experience working in an Agile or project-based development environment
  • Interest in the space sector, data-driven products, or digital consulting

    • Benefits
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Profit sharing bonus (prime intéressement)
  • Meal voucher - Swile : 12€ / working day 
  • Remote work : 2 days / week
  • International environment

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

 


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

Arbeitsort: Rotkreuz (ZG)

PULSCOM! ist eine Marketing- und Kommunikationsagentur mit Kunden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich. Wir arbeiten für innovative Unternehmen verschiedenster Branchen – von regional bis national ausgerichtet. Unsere Stärke liegt in der intelligenten Verknüpfung aller Kommunikationskanäle: Print trifft Online, Strategie trifft Kreation, Idee trifft Umsetzung. Mit unserer eigenen Online- und Internetagentur für Kampagnen, Social Media und Performance Marketing sowie einer modernen Bildagentur für Fotografie, 3D-Visualisierungen, Renderings, Videos und TV-Spots realisieren wir integrierte Kommunikationslösungen auf hohem Niveau.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen eines zwölfmonatigen Praktikums erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, schrittweise in die Rolle einer Projektleiterin oder eines Projektleiters hineinzuwachsen. Sie wirken an Konzepten und Strategien mit, koordinieren Projekte im Bereich Online und Offline, begleiten Kommunikationsmassnahmen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung und übernehmen Verantwortung in Planung, Organisation und Qualitätssicherung. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit unseren Kunden sowie dem internen Kreativteam zusammen und gewinnen umfassende Einblicke in die Abläufe einer Agentur.

Qualifikation

Ihre Muttersprache ist Deutsch oder Schweizerdeutsch, Sie verfügen über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und idealerweise über Kenntnisse in Französisch oder Italienisch. Ihr Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) oder ein gleichwertiger akademischer Hintergrund bildet die Grundlage für dieses Praktikum. Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind neugierig, kreativ und bereit, Neues zu lernen.

Bei uns erwartet Sie ein praxisnahes und abwechslungsreiches Jahr, in dem Sie vielseitige Projekte begleiten, wertvolle Erfahrungen sammeln und die Arbeit einer Agentur aus nächster Nähe kennenlernen. Sie arbeiten in einem motivierten Team an unserem modernen Standort in Rotkreuz mit guter ÖV-Anbindung und haben die Möglichkeit, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Das Praktikum bietet Ihnen die Chance, praktische Fähigkeiten aufzubauen und den direkten Einstieg in die Berufswelt des Marketings und der Kommunikation zu schaffen. Wir sind daran interessiert, engagierten Praktikantinnen und Praktikanten auch eine langfristige Perspektive zu bieten – bei entsprechender Eignung besteht die Möglichkeit einer späteren Festanstellung.

data.description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.
